2024 brought the highest highs and the lowest lows—it challenged me personally yet skyrocketed my career. My body forced me to slow down, and for the first time, I faced the toll of living in survival mode for so long. I realized that unprocessed emotions, stress, and trauma don’t just disappear—they show up when you least expect. Between balancing a dream job, household duties, caregiving, and dog-mom life, I’m rediscovering who I am beyond all the hats I wear. Some days feel triumphant; others, I’m fighting through imposter syndrome. But little by little, I’m finding joy in the small moments, building real self-care habits, and making space for the projects I’ve always wanted to pursue. If you’ve ever felt torn between your ambitions and your well-being, you’re not alone.
